title: Hey everyone:) I just released a new update for TileMaker DOT (v2.8.8)!
author: ObjectiveCrysis22
selftext:
This update brings a massive architectural change: objects and NPCs are no longer strictly grid-locked, allowing you to place, drag, and position items at exact X/Y pixel coordinates! Moving away from rigid grid arrays has also made Undo and Redo significantly faster, especially on large maps.

I’ve also added a tile-snap toggle, improved click-and-drag handling anywhere on an object, refined depth sorting, fixed playtest collisions, and updated all export pipelines (JSON, TMX, CSV, LVL) to support free-form coordinates. Note that this X/Y coordinate update is part of the Pro Workflow Edition.

Official site Itch.io: https://crytek22.itch.io/tilemakerdot

GitHub: https://github.com/andrei-voia/TileMakerDOT

YouTube tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3fiajGU32Jg

For anyone unfamiliar with the project, TileMaker DOT is a Free (with a very complete, professional paid cheap version too), open source 2D map editor I'm building. It uses a data first, ID based workflow and handles visual depth sorting automatically so you don't have to manage multiple layers for object heights.

Give it a try and let me know if you have any feedback! If the editor helps with your projects and you want to support development, a rating or a small donation on Itch is always appreciated.

Thank you all for your support!
